turns.text: What security and privacy measures should be included in a PHR app handling health data?

must_contain: A PHR app never sends an Aadhaar number, mobile number, ABHA number, OTP or password in clear text; each is encrypted with the PHR public certificate
The app lets a person see a consent request, change it before allowing it, allow or refuse it, see what is already allowed, and take it back at any time
When a consent is revoked, sharing under it stops immediately, not at the end of the period
notes: NHA PHR review, 30 September 2026, case 4: 'Seems fine'. Verdict group: fine. The reviewer accepted this answer; the case holds it in place while the shapes change.
